# execution-modes

Read and follow [the canonical `execution-modes` skill](../../../agent-orchestration/skills/execution-modes/SKILL.md) from the pinned agent-orchestration kit (if it's missing, run `git submodule update --init agent-orchestration`). Its own links resolve beside it.

This repository's rules come first: AGENTS.md, "Agent kits", and the documents it names. Attended: about 15 minutes from report to a fix he can see, with checks of 5 minutes or less. Unattended: 45-minute time-boxes, each ending in a merge of what works (AGENTS.md, Working modes).
